ov: A large wild goat of the mountains of Central and South Asia. Both sexes have corkscrew horns, up to 160 cm long in males, and males grow a long shaggy mane. It is the national animal of Pakistan and is listed as Near Threatened.

why.et: Poached for food and for its horns, which some believe have medicinal properties.

rg: Mountains of Afghanistan, Pakistan, north-west India (Jammu and Kashmir), Tajikistan, Uzbekistan and Turkmenistan.
df: Grazes in spring and summer and browses in winter, sometimes standing on its hind legs to reach high branches.
fx: Its name is often read as "snake eater", from an old belief that it kills and eats snakes.
Its alarm call sounds very like the bleat of a domestic goat.
